integrity: The proof is algebraic. The representative replay uses exact rational arithmetic and is supplementary rather than evidentiary for the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The result is a necessity witness for the generic radius-rule framework, not a failure of the five concrete mechanisms proved in the source to satisfy Condition C.1.
It establishes that C.1 cannot simply be omitted while retaining C.2 and C.3; it does not prove C.1 is the weakest possible replacement in every specialized trust-region method.
Targeted database and full-text checks reduce but do not eliminate residual historical-literature risk.
title: A scalar quadratic witness makes the trust-region radius lower bound indispensable
